text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy. Prepared for Reuters by domestic news agency ETA.
- Popular actor Sulev Luik was brutally killed last Saturday near his home.
- The Baltic Sea Countries' foreign ministers are meeting in Riga to discuss regional cooperation.
- ERA Pank, Uhispank and Forexpank have begun after a two-month break to accept loan applications from tenants.
- Prime Minister Mart Siimann rejected accusations from the rightist Reform Party of a left turn and a call by other opposition party the Centre Party for a progressive income tax.
- Estonian psychologists have departed for Latvia to help a local crisis team coping with an accident at the weekend in which eight children were killed.
- The Tallinn city government has proposed increasing kindergarten rates by a maximum of 300 kroons per month.
- The first child from a frozen embryo was born on June 27.
- Russia has appointed Alexey Glukhov its new ambassador to Estonia. He is currently Russian ambassador to Luxembourg.
